scripts.build: npm run openapi && npm run build -w @openapps/mcp && npm run build:web-assets && npm run build -w @openapps/web-worker && npm run build -w @openapps/jobs-worker
scripts.build:web-assets: npm run build -w frontend && npm run sync-docs -w @openapps/docs-site && npm run build -w @openapps/docs-site && node scripts/merge-docs.mjs
scripts.check: npm run cf:types:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.openapi: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate-openapi.mjs && npm run api:contract -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @openapps/core && npm run typecheck -w @openapps/db && npm run typecheck -w @openapps/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @openapps/scrapers && npm run build -w @openapps/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @openapps/web-worker && npm run typecheck -w @openapps/jobs-worker && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test:workers: vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.web.config.ts
scripts.cf:types: npm run cf:types -w @openapps/web-worker && npm run cf:types -w @openapps/jobs-worker
scripts.cf:types:check: npm run cf:types:check -w @openapps/web-worker && npm run cf:types:check -w @openapps/jobs-worker
scripts.cf:dry-run: npm run deploy:dry -w @openapps/web-worker && npm run deploy:dry -w @openapps/jobs-worker
scripts.cf:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply openapps-production --local --config workers/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply openapps-production --remote --config workers/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply openapps-preview --remote --env preview --config workers/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web-assets && npm run cf:migrate:remote && npm run deploy -w @openapps/web-worker
